about: What a desktop Markdown editor is expected to do, whatever it looks like — the gaps a user hit that Notion parity doesn't cover. Sources: Typora's menus and shortcuts (support.typora.io/Shortcut-Keys), its auto-save and draft recovery (support.typora.io/Auto-Save), and ordinary Windows/macOS document-app behaviour. Same statuses as notion.json; every 'must' is checked by `npm run parity` in the real app. Native dialogs (open, save, confirm, print) can't be clicked over the debugging protocol, so the checks answer them through dev-only stubs (platform.js `stub`) — the flows around the dialog are real.

features.feature: Opening BlockMD with no file shows a new, empty Untitled document (no demo text)
Opening BlockMD reopens the last file you opened or edited; close without doing anything and the next launch is a new document
An empty .md (a new file, or a .txt renamed) opens, takes typing and saves
File ▸ New (Ctrl+N) starts an empty document, asking first about unsaved changes
File ▸ Open (Ctrl+O)
File ▸ Open Recent lists recently opened files; a missing one is removed
Save (Ctrl+S) writes the file; the title shows • while there are unsaved changes
Saving an untitled document asks where, then keeps that name
Save As (Ctrl+Shift+S) writes a copy under a new name and continues there
A save that fails (read-only file) says so and keeps the text unsaved
The file changed by another program: reloaded if clean, asked about if there are unsaved changes
Unsaved changes survive a crash and are offered back on the next launch
Dropping a .md file on the window opens it
features.note: The check calls the drop handler directly; an OS drag can't be simulated

features.feature: File ▸ Close Window (Ctrl+W), asking first about unsaved changes
Print / Export PDF (Ctrl+P), printing only the document
An app menu with File / Edit / View / Help, each item showing its shortcut
Edit ▸ Undo / Redo
Copy as Markdown (Ctrl+Shift+C)
Paste as Plain Text (Ctrl+Shift+V)
Replace (Ctrl+H): one match or all, editing only the matched blocks
Find next / previous (F3 / Shift+F3)
Select word (Ctrl+D) / line (Ctrl+L)
features.note: Ctrl+D duplicates the block, as in Notion; double- and triple-click select a word and a paragraph

features.feature: Show the Markdown source (View ▸ Show Source)
Zoom in / out / actual size (Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0), remembered
Full screen (F11)
Word count in the status bar (CJK characters counted one each)
Outline / file tree sidebar
Focus and typewriter modes
Ctrl+click a link: web links open in the browser, .md links open in BlockMD
Help ▸ Check for Updates says whether there is one
Help ▸ About shows the version
Several documents at once (tabs or windows)
Optional auto-save
Files in encodings other than UTF-8 (e.g. GBK)
features.note: Refused with a clear message today: saving them back byte-for-byte needs an encoder for that charset

features.feature: Export to HTML / Word
